question: Does a tight-base 4% breakout (burst) triggered on Monday produce better stop-based R than Tue-Fri? Same reversed-Monday-effect hypothesis as the other cohorts, tested here on the higher-quality burst trigger; expect WEAK given the small burst n and documented decay of calendar effects.
plain: Tests whether Monday helps tight-base breakout (burst) triggers, per Indian day-of-week studies showing a reversed (positive) Monday effect vs the US.
